new.note: Vanilla ice cream floated in ice-cold Coca-Cola, long spoon and a straw. Deloris wants a cut of every shoe sold.
new.how: Chill 1.5 L Coca-Cola. Put 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of 4 tall glasses and pour the Coke slowly down the side so it foams up. Serve with a long spoon and a straw.

r2.make_ahead: Chill the Coke; build to serve

steps.text: Put 2 scoops of ice cream in each of 4 tall glasses.
Pour the cold Coke slowly down the side so it foams, and serve with a long spoon and a straw.

new.note: Lime juice, blue curaçao syrup and soda shaken over ice, with a salted rim.
new.how: Run a lime wedge round the rims of 4 glasses and dip them in salt. Shake the juice of 4 limes and 80ml blue curaçao syrup with ice, strain into the glasses over fresh ice and top with 600ml soda water.

r2.make_ahead: Squeeze the limes up to a few hours ahead; shake to serve

steps.text: Rub the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip them in salt.
Shake the lime juice and syrup with ice, strain over fresh ice and top with soda.

new.note: Fresh lemon juice and sugar stirred over ice, topped with cold soda water.
new.how: Stir the juice of 5 lemons with 100g caster sugar until it dissolves. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, divide the lemon mix between them and top with 800ml cold soda water. Add a lemon wheel to each.

r2.make_ahead: Make the lemon syrup up to a day ahead; top with soda to serve

steps.text: Stir the juice of 5 lemons with the sugar until it dissolves.
Pour over ice in 4 tall glasses, top with soda and add a lemon wheel.

new.note: Fresh lime, cherry syrup and soda over crushed ice, a cherry on top.
new.how: Stir the juice of 4 limes with 80ml cherry syrup. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice, divide the lime mix between them and top with 600ml soda water. Finish each with a cocktail cherry.

r2.make_ahead: Squeeze the limes ahead; build to serve

steps.text: Stir the lime juice with the cherry syrup.
Pour over crushed ice, top with soda and add a cherry.

new.note: Lemon juice and syrup shaken cold, topped with sparkling water in a flute, long twist.
new.how: Shake the juice of 3 lemons and 60ml sugar syrup with ice. Strain into 4 flutes, top with 500ml chilled sparkling water and finish each with a long lemon twist.

r2.make_ahead: Squeeze the lemons ahead; shake to serve

steps.text: Shake the lemon juice and syrup with ice and strain into 4 flutes.
Top with sparkling water and add a long lemon twist.

new.note: Fresh lemon and sugar shaken with ice and soda, in jam jars, for the bridge run.
new.how: Shake the juice of 4 lemons and 80ml sugar syrup with ice. Strain into 4 ice-filled jam jars and top with 600ml soda water.

r2.make_ahead: Squeeze the lemons ahead; shake to serve

steps.text: Shake the lemon juice and syrup with ice.
Strain into 4 ice-filled jam jars and top with soda.
